items.text: An HR business partner works with business leaders on hiring, performance, team health and change, and the path usually runs through HR operations or generalist work, then a business unit, and needs fair judgement, knowledge of labour rules and the ability to read business numbers.
Build depth in one HR area, learn how one business earns money and keep case notes that show fair, careful decisions.
Check the current rules before advising.
